title: APPEAL/1/2026 — GANPAT RAM vs. RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
text:
Court of Registrar
DEBTS RECOVERY TRIBUNAL, JAIPUR
Item No. 02
APPEAL/1/2026 IN OA/259/2023
GANPAT RAM Vs RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
Dated: - 26.03.2026
Present: -
Shri Sanjay Kumar Shukla, counsel for applicant
Shri Bhagwan Singh, counsel for respondent bank
Shri Basant Joshi, counsel for auction purchaser.
Counsel for auction purchaser has filed vakalatnama vide dy no.
4040/2026 but not filed reply to appeal.
Counsel for respondent bank has also not filed reply to appeal.
Case be listed before Hon’ble Presiding Officer on 17.04.2026 for order on
reply.
Registrar
